title: Abstract module formula for pair base change
statement: Let S,T,A,B,A′,B′ be schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Fix f:A→S, g:B→S, p:T→S, v:A′→A, w:B′→B, f′:A′→T, g′:B′→T satisfying v≫f=f′≫p and w≫g=g′≫p. Put K=A×_S B, K′=A′×_T B′ with projections s₁,s₂ and r₁,r₂ [def-pc-fibre-product], and l:K′→K any map satisfying l≫s₁=r₁≫v and l≫s₂=r₂≫w. These equations uniquely identify it with the canonical pullback lift. Let N and M be module sheaves on A and B [def-pc-module-pullback], and φ:s₁*N→s₂*M any morphism. Let βa:l*s₁*N≅r₁*v*N be pullbackCompOfEq l s₁ (r₁≫v), using the lift projection equation, followed by inverse pullback composition along r₁,v, and define βb similarly from l,s₂,r₂,w,M. Then the pair base change of φ [def-pc-overlap-pair-canonical-comparisons] equals βa.inv≫l*(φ)≫βb.hom. All comparisons are canonical and compositions are in Lean order.

source.place: Tags 0095, 0096 and 0097, adjunction and composition of inverse images; Tag 01ZR (2), first proof

proof.text: The two prescribed projection equations identify l with the canonical lift by pullback hom extensionality. Substitute that equality. Expand overlapPairBaseChangeHom and pullHom. The two mapComp components are inverse pullback composition and pullback composition, by modulesPseudofunctor_mapComp_inv_app and modulesPseudofunctor_mapComp_hom_app. The two mapComp prime components are pullbackCompOfEq inverse and hom, by modulesPseudofunctor_mapComp prime hom_app_eq and inv_app_eq. Their middle map is l*φ. Regroup the source and target factors as βa inverse and βb hom using the formulas for inverse and hom of a composite isomorphism and associativity.

lean.statement:
theorem overlap_base_change_formula
    {S T A B A' B' : Scheme.{u}} (f : A ⟶ S) (g : B ⟶ S) (p : T ⟶ S)
    (v : A' ⟶ A) (w : B' ⟶ B) (f' : A' ⟶ T) (g' : B' ⟶ T)
    (hv : v ≫ f = f' ≫ p) (hw : w ≫ g = g' ≫ p)
    (N : A.Modules) (M : B.Modules)
    (φ : (Scheme.Modules.pullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj N ⟶
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (pullback.snd f g)).obj M)
    (l : pullback f' g' ⟶ pullback f g)
    (hlf : l ≫ pullback.fst f g = pullback.fst f' g' ≫ v)
    (hls : l ≫ pullback.snd f g = pullback.snd f' g' ≫ w) :
    let βa := pullbackCompOfEq l (pullback.fst f g) (pullback.fst f' g' ≫ v)
        hlf N ≪≫
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp (pullback.fst f' g') v).app N).symm
    let βb := pullbackCompOfEq l (pullback.snd f g) (pullback.snd f' g' ≫ w)
        hls M ≪≫
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp (pullback.snd f' g') w).app M).symm
    modulesPseudofunctor.overlapPairBaseChangeHom f g p v w f' g' hv hw N M φ =
      βa.inv ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pullback l).map φ ≫ βb.hom
